title: SF2827 (2023-2024 Regular): Machine guns regulation modifications

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Minnesota) (gun-policy Stage 5, Minnesota); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Minnesota text (Introduction, 2023-03-09; official copy, https://www.revisor.mn.gov/bills/93/2023/0/SF/2827/versions/0/)
provenance.note: Introduced bill (2023-03-09). Strikes 'or a short-barreled shotgun', 'five' and '$10,000' from the old paragraph and moves short-barreled shotguns to paragraph (b) with the old penalty. Effective August 1, 2023. Version read is the introduced bill as filed; no later version was read.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.67, subd. 2): (a) Except as otherwise provided herein, whoever owns, possesses, or operates a machine gun, or any trigger activator or machine gun conversion kit may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than 20 years or to payment of a fine of not more than $35,000, or both.
Section 1 (Minn. Stat. 609.67, subd. 2): (b) Except as otherwise provided herein, whoever owns, possesses, or operates a short-barreled shotgun may be sentenced to imprisonment for not more than five years or to payment of a fine of not more than $10,000, or both.
